ns2:course.label: Sustainable Design of the Built Environment
ns2:course.description: This seminar introduces fundamental readings in sustainability and resilient design. Presents diverse perspectives on sustainability, encouraging students to understand and critique different meanings of sustainability over time and geography. Approved for Letter and S/U grading. Prerequisite: Priority given for majors.
